target.title: fix(active-memory): bound timeout circuit breakers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Active Memory keeps a process-local `timeoutCircuitBreaker` map keyed by `agentId:provider/model`. Entries were only removed when the same key was checked after cooldown or after a later success. Distinct failing agent/model combinations could accumulate forever; expired keys that were never touched again were never reclaimed.

## Why This Change Was Made

Bound the map on its owner mutation path (`recordCircuitBreakerTimeout`): purge cooldown-expired entries using the **normalized configured** `circuitBreakerCooldownMs`, then evict oldest `lastTimeoutAt` until under `DEFAULT_MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES` (1000) before inserting a new key. Updating an existing key refreshes counters/time and purges expired peers without evicting the active key.

## User Impact

**Before:** Each new failing agent/provider/model pair could permanently add process state; purge ignored non-default cooldowns.
**After:** Peer purge honors configured cooldown (5s?600s); remaining breaker state has a hard cap.

## Evidence

- Production call site: `recordCircuitBreakerTimeout(cbKey, Date.now(), params.config.circuitBreakerCooldownMs)`
- Node: v24.18.0 / Windows
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/active-memory/index.test.ts -t "runtime proof|honors a shorter|honors a longer|bounds timeout|purges cooldown"` ? **5 passed**
- Unit: cap@1000, cooldown 5s / 60s / 120s peer retention
- Runtime (plugin hook path): see Real behavior proof

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Active Memory timeout circuit breaker records distinct keys on the real `before_prompt_build` timeout path, skips further embedded runs when open, and logs the skip; map size tracks timed-out agents.
**Environment tested:** Windows, Node v24.18.0, worktree `codex/active-memory-bound-timeout-breakers`, plugin registered via `plugin.register`, recall forced to timeout via aborting `runEmbeddedAgent`.
**Steps run after the patch:** Configured 8 agents, `timeoutMs=25`, `circuitBreakerMaxTimeouts=1`, `logging=true`; invoked `before_prompt_build` until each timed out; re-invoked agent0 and captured redacted `api.logger.info` lines.
**Evidence after fix:**

```json
{
  "path": "before_prompt_build ? recordCircuitBreakerTimeout(config.circuitBreakerCooldownMs)",
  "timeoutMs": 25,
  "circuitBreakerMaxTimeouts": 1,
  "circuitBreakerCooldownMs": 60000,
  "distinctAgentsAttempted": 8,
  "distinctAgentsTimedOut": 8,
  "breakerMapSize": 8,
  "embeddedRuns": 8,
  "skippedAdditionalRunOnOpenBreaker": true,
  "redactedPluginLogs": [
    "active-memory: agent=cbagent7 session=<redacted> activeProvider=github-copilot activeModel=gpt-5.4-mini done status=timeout elapsedMs=27 summaryChars=0",
    "active-memory: agent=cbagent0 session=<redacted> activeProvider=github-copilot activeModel=gpt-5.4-mini skipped (circuit breaker open after consecutive timeouts)"
  ]
}
```

**Observed result:** 8 distinct timeout keys in the breaker map; 9th call for agent0 did not call embedded agent and logged `skipped (circuit breaker open after consecutive timeouts)`.
**Not tested:** Full live gateway process with real memory slot backends; 1000-key cap under live gateway soak (covered by unit eviction test).
